title: Small detail in my pixel art chess game: the victory animation is graded by who you just captured - take a pawn and you get a clipped salute, take the queen and the piece gets the full dance
text: This is chess where the pieces fight: every capture cuts away to a hand-animated duel, and the flourish afterwards depends on the rank of the victim. Pawn, knight or bishop and the winner's salute is cut off at 0.55 seconds; rook or queen and it plays the whole celebration clip. Nobody asked for that level of pettiness, but it is in there. It is a hotseat chess game for Windows too, offline with no ads. On the Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9PP9G5CQKKZX

title: Pixel Pawns: chess where every capture is an animated duel (23-second trailer)
text:
Pixel Pawns is our pixel-art chess for Windows PC: classic chess rules, but every capture turns into an animated duel between the two pieces. Here is the 23-second trailer: https://youtu.be/kg31aqvjqZw

Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9PP9G5CQKKZX
Website: https://pixelpawns.bugfactory.hu
